Signature Medium

Essentials Medium

6 cuts, up to 21 lbs, $159
Same high‑quality meat and seafood, but from a more limited selection of core cuts only (no specialty cuts)
Best if you mainly want everyday staples (ground beef, chicken breasts, pork chops, etc.) at a lower price.

Both include:

Access to member deals and add‑ons
Free shipping and flexible scheduling (change frequency, bill date, and cuts before billing)
Access to our recipe library and other member perks.
